'''Gaffer Gamgee It surround us...and binds us...holds the galaxy together...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaffer Gamgee]]
* '''Published:''' 30 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 MWYHL Gamgee LS 2003 Itsurrou.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Fairly standard Jedi Training deck.

The published list has 55 cards.

== Strategy ==

In this deck, I am going to train Son of Skywalker. It seems that it is more popular to train Daughter of Skywalker, but I couldn't resist training Luke with this virtualized version of him.

Anyway, the major problem that I've found with this deck is early game force drains against it. I am hoping that It Could Be Worse can handle that.

A final note: I know this deck could use a copy of Luke's Lightsaber. If anyone has one of those to trade, could they email me: sanders@uclink.berkeley.edu

Thanks!
